It sounds like you’ve found a meaningful and intentional ritual that adds structure and confidence to your morning routine—something that many people appreciate! Taking the time to groom yourself can be a form of self-care, a way to express your personal style, or even a way to mentally transition into the day ahead. What you’re describing aligns with the idea of **"ritualistic preparation"**—a practice that helps people feel more in control, intentional, and ready to face challenges. Studies in psychology suggest that small, deliberate actions like grooming can boost self-esteem and create a sense of readiness, which might explain why it feels so satisfying for you. If you enjoy the process, it’s a great habit to maintain! It’s also worth noting that grooming can be a form of mindfulness—focusing on the present moment rather than rushing through the day.
